skill_name: Comment on the following statement: "Schools should be closed in winter breaks."
workflow: Schools should take into consideration closing during winter breaks if necessary to prioritize the safety of students and staff. Winter break is usually a time for family vacations and time off, so an extended vacation for students could be beneficial for their mental health and wellbeing. Additionally, closing schools during a long break might help reduce the spread of any illnesses, as there would be less contact between people.
